mutants.description: Accepts URL objects but drops the existing string API.
Supports both input shapes but assumes port 80 for every protocol.
mutants.patch:
diff --git a/src/endpoint.mjs b/src/endpoint.mjs
--- a/src/endpoint.mjs
+++ b/src/endpoint.mjs
@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
 export function parseEndpoint(value) {
-  const url = new URL(value.includes('://') ? value : `http://${value}`)
+  const url = value instanceof URL
+    ? value
+    : new URL(value.includes('://') ? value : `http://${value}`)
   return { host: url.hostname, port: Number(url.port || 80) }
 }
